root_cause.text: ksmbd_crypt_message() sets a NULL completion callback and treats the -EINPROGRESS return code from async crypto engines as an error, causing it to free the request before the hardware DMA operation completes, leading to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states "ksmbd_crypt_message() sets a NULL completion callback on AEAD requests and does not handle the -EINPROGRESS return code from async hardware crypto engines... When QCE returns -EINPROGRESS, ksmbd treats it as an error and immediately frees the request while the hardware DMA operation is still in flight." Patch replaces the faulty pattern with crypto_wait_req() and crypto_req_done() to properly synchronize.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing crypto wait object to ensure synchronous completion of cryptographic operations in SMB message encryption/decryption.
intent_record.what: Added DECLARE_CRYPTO_WAIT(wait) declaration inside ksmbd_crypt_message function.
intent_record.how: Declares a crypto_wait structure that allows the function to wait for completion of asynchronous crypto operations, preventing potential race conditions or incomplete data processing.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix asynchronous crypto operation handling by using crypto_wait_req to properly wait for completion.
intent_record.what: Changed aead_request_set_callback flags to include CRYPTO_TFM_REQ_MAY_BACKLOG and set callback to crypto_req_done with &wait; replaced direct crypto_aead_encrypt/decrypt calls with crypto_wait_req wrapping them.
intent_record.how: Ensures the crypto operation is properly waited upon using a completion variable, preventing potential use of incomplete data and making asynchronous crypto operations reliable.

candidates.rationale: Sets the completion callback to NULL, so asynchronous crypto operations never complete, causing the request to be freed while DMA is still in progress.
This condition treats the -EINPROGRESS return code (non-zero) as an error, leading to premature freeing of the request before async completion.
Transfers control to free resources (including the aead_request) while the async operation may still be using them, causing use-after-free.
Invokes an asynchronous encrypt operation whose return value (-EINPROGRESS) is not properly handled due to the NULL callback and immediate error check.
Invokes an asynchronous decrypt operation whose return value (-EINPROGRESS) is not properly handled due to the NULL callback and immediate error check.

vuln_statements.explanation: Sets a NULL completion callback for the asynchronous AEAD request, so the crypto engine never signals completion, causing the request to be freed while the hardware DMA may still be in progress.
Invokes an asynchronous encrypt operation that may return -EINPROGRESS. Without proper callback handling, this return value is misinterpreted as an error.
Invokes an asynchronous decrypt operation that may return -EINPROGRESS. Without proper callback handling, this return value is misinterpreted as an error.
Treats any non-zero return code, including -EINPROGRESS from async operations, as an error, leading to premature freeing of the crypto request before completion.
